title: File:Black Canyon National Recreation Trail (52633877433).jpg
claims: The image looks down a broad desert canyon with a pale wash, dense green scrub, saguaro-covered slopes and layered ridges under a partly cloudy sky.

The Commons description places the photograph along the Black Canyon National Recreation Trail near Black Canyon City, Arizona, and credits Chris Wonderly / Bureau of Land Management Arizona; it is a canyon-corridor landscape, not a race-day photograph, and shows no course marking, runner or aid station.
The author is BLMArizona; the file is public domain; the photograph was taken on 2023-01-14 at 11:43:49; the original is 4,032 x 3,024 pixels and 7,222,301 bytes.
The route page uses a 960 x 720 copy of 325,804 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits BLM Arizona / Chris Wonderly, public domain, Wikimedia Commons.
